notes:
Workshop summary (10/28 sizing workshop) - concise bullets and artifacts:
- Attendees: Jordan (AE), Priya (SE), Lucas (CSM), infra lead (M. Santos), SRE (T. Huang), security (A. Ruiz).
- Context: large-scale conversational assistant + document search for wealth-management clients. Peak SLAs during market open windows (09:30-10:30 ET).
- Baseline traffic: measured steady-state QPS = 120 qps (avg request ~120 tokens). Baseline tokens/sec = 14,400 tokens/sec.
- Peak profile observed in prototype: 10 min bursts up to 600 qps (avg 120 tokens) => burst tokens/sec = 72,000 tokens/sec. Weekend background indexing embedding jobs add 30k tokens/sec sustained during maintenance windows.
- Latency targets: desired p50 < 80ms, p95 < 300ms for single-turn chat responses (150-250 token outputs). Must guarantee p99 < 1s for priority routes.
- Model preferences: open-weight 70B quantized family for cost reasons; fallback plan to 34B full-precision for latency-sensitive routes. Interested in mixed-precision (int8) and KV cache reuse.
- Throughput guarantees requested: committed capacity to support 100k tokens/sec steady with ability to absorb 200% burst for five minutes. Want explicit token/sec SLA and GPU pool isolation.
- Workshop outputs: preliminary sizing recommends 10x A100-80GB equiv dedicated GPU nodes (split across 2 AZs) with autoscale headroom of +4 nodes for bursts, continuous KV caching, and request-level routing to a lower-cost hosted fallover for overflow traffic.
- Benchmarks: internal perf tests show 1 A100 equiv handles ~12k tokens/sec for 70B-quantized for median latency envelope — team wants Redwood to run black-box benchmarks with their anonymized prompt set.
- Reliability/SLA asks: 99.95% availability for dedicated pool, scheduled maintenance window not to exceed 2h/month, 1h pre-notice for maintenance, 30-minute SRE escalation response for Sev1, credit formula tied to token/sec shortfall.
- Security/compliance: require SSO (SAML), KMS integration for model keys, audit logs retained 1 year, and data residency in us-east-1 for PII workloads.
- Cost sensitivity: target blended cost/token lower than current self-hosted baseline by 20% after quantization and batching.
- POC plan: 2-week dedicated trial (10 nodes) with real workload replay, followed by 4-week evaluation of failover behavior during peak bursts.
- Quote from Infra lead: "We need deterministic tail latency during market open or the product is unusable."
- Stubs/links: perf harness (drive), call transcript FF-20251107-qtb, Jira: INF-9981 for onprem network QOS testing.
- Next deliverables: Redwood to produce: 1) sizing workbook with token/sec -> node map, 2) draft SLA with token-based credits, 3) run 3 black-box benchmarks using client prompt set (requested by 11/24).
